name: Salsa Burgers
tagline: DIP IT LIKE YOU MEAN IT
voice: Bold, imperative, sauce-first. Every sentence is a command. Never 'delicious' or 'best'. Bilingual EN/ES flavor. If Shake Shack could post it, it isn't Salsa enough.
rules: Dark background as the default hero look; the sauce is always the brightest object.
Inspired-by, not exact: no real public figures' likenesses, no copyrighted works/marks.
No permanent discounts; promos are time-boxed.
The black glove and the sauce pour are recurring ownable motifs.
